pose.definition:
n. a posture assumed by models for photographic or artistic purposes
v. pretend to be someone you are not; sometimes with fraudulent intentions

pose.translation:
n. 姿势, 姿态, 装模作样, 伪装

poseidon.definition: n. (Greek mythology) the god of the sea and earthquakes in ancient mythology; brother of Zeus and Hades and Hera; identified with Roman Neptune
